changelog: Automatically upgrades all existing Windows and Android configs to 4 parallel upstream sockets, enables true multi-socket round-robin for local traffic (127.0.0.1), improves Help page responsive layout, and falls back to all servers if top European latency checks fail.

android.changelog: Automatically upgrades Android config to 4 parallel upstream sockets, distributes local loopback connections across all 4 sockets, prioritizes low-latency European servers, and bumps version_code cleanly.
